content:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Ventana Therapeutics (acct VENT-001) — Dedicated EU embeddings: elevated 5xx rate (~27%) and tail latency. Incident ID VEN-01. Pager: eng-oncall. Link: https://ops.redwood.com/incidents/VEN-01

alice-eng-oncall: taking this. jumping in now.

bob-sre: on my way, any quick repro or sample logs you can paste?

alice-eng-oncall: quick trace from the pool (truncate):
```
2026-03-15T12:34:56Z ERROR inference: embed_req failed status=500 model=embed-small-eu node=gpu-eu-03 kvcache=MISS err=out_of_memory
2026-03-15T12:34:58Z WARN autoscaler: scale_suggestion +2 replicas due to queue depth
2026-03-15T12:35:05Z ERROR routing: prefix_cache eviction thrash for acct=VENT-001
```

carla-cs: FYI Ventana CS contact matrix (prod):
- Primary: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@ventana.bio> (SRE)
- Secondary: Jim Park <jim.park@ventana.bio> (CTO)
- AM: Frank Reeves <frank.reeves@redwood.com>
Please include tailored impact: "Embeddings powering search and inference in production are experiencing failures and increased latency; we are actively mitigating."

dan-support: customers hitting errors in embedding endpoints; are we rolling to hosted fallback? need ETA for mitigation to pass to Ventana.

alice-eng-oncall: plan: 1) apply routing override for acct VENT-001 to route to hosted-embed-fallback (us-west) 2) temporarily increase dedicated pool autoscale min for eu to 4 3) monitor for 15m then update status page. Executing step 1 now.

alice-eng-oncall: command run:
```
# apply routing override
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"account_id":"VENT-001","target":"hosted-embed-fallback","ttl":900}'
```

bob-sre: joining on the nodes, will watch OOMs and kernel traces. I'll follow up if we need emergency rollback.

frank-am: drafting customer notification. please review and approve for send to Maria/Jim:
> Hi Maria/Jim,
> 
> We detected an issue impacting embeddings for Ventana on our Dedicated EU pool causing elevated errors and latency. We have applied a temporary routing override to route your embedding traffic to a hosted fallback in US-West to restore service while we stabilize the EU pool. Expected impact: brief increase in embedding latency for some requests (100-300ms), no data loss.
> 
> Next steps: we are scaling the EU pool and investigating root cause; we will send an update within 30 minutes and a post-incident summary once resolved.
> 
> Apologies for the disruption — Frank (AM) / Maria (CS) cc.

carla-cs: looks good. suggest adding: "If you see any functional regression, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize." Approved. :thumbsup: 

alice-eng-oncall: override applied. errors dropped from 27% -> 1.2% in the last 5m for VENT-001. Rolling metrics: 
```
metric: embed_errors_percent (VENT-001) 5m avg
- before: 27.3%
- after: 1.2%
latency_p50 increased by ~120ms for routed requests
```

incident-bot: Status page update published: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/VEN-01 -- short summary: "Partial outage for embeddings in EU Dedicated affecting Ventana Therapeutics. Traffic routed to hosted fallback; mitigation in progress."

ela-oncall: taking 1hr watch. leaving handoff notes in the incident doc: https://ops.redwood.com/incidents/VEN-01/runbook.md

alice-eng-oncall: handing to @ela-oncall for overnight monitoring. key leads: bob-sre (investigating OOMs), alice-eng-oncall (owner), carla-cs (customer comms).

frank-am: sent the notification to Maria/Jim and copied the CS ticket: CS-8421. I'll follow up with a scheduled call if needed.

dan-support: marking support ticket linked to incident: SUP-3345. updating customers who reply.

alice-eng-oncall: summary for handoff: cause suspected kernel memory pressure on the EU embed runtime causing KV cache thrash and OOMs under prefix-heavy workload for VENT-001. Mitigation: routing override to hosted fallback + increased autoscale. Next steps: reproduce locally with prefix-heavy test, remediate kernel/allocator, roll a stabilized node pool.

ela-oncall: acknowledged, will escalate if errors creep above 3% again.

carla-cs: closing internal comms draft and putting final note on customer-facing update after final verification.

incident-bot: Incident VEN-01 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
